blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Fisherfolk on Siargao Island, Surigao del Norte have received a major boost in value-added production with the approval of an P87-million milkfish (bangus) consolidation, processing, and marketing facility project. The Regional Project Advisory Board (RPAB) in Caraga approved the project on Thursday last week, which will be run by the Consolacion Agri-Fishery Multi-Purpose Cooperative (FISHCOOP), a Dapa-based group in Surigao del Norte known for producing bottled bangus. Lynn Pareñas, head of the I-REAP (Investments in Rural Enterprises and Agricultural and Fishery Productivity) component, called the approval an “answered prayer” for FISHCOOP.
